exists.description: false when the resolver returned NXDOMAIN

data.description: Record data. TXT strings are unquoted and joined.

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, MX, TXT

authenticated.description: DNSSEC AD flag from the resolver

records.description: One entry per requested record type

description: Resolves live DNS records for any domain or hostname via 1.1.1.1: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA in one call (type=ALL), or a single type incl. SRV, PTR, DS, DNSKEY, HTTPS. Clean JSON with TTLs, NXDOMAIN flag and DNSSEC-authenticated bit. A URL or email address is reduced to its host. Use when an agent needs to verify a domain, find mail servers or nameservers, or read TXT/SPF records. $0.01 USDC on Base. Paid tool: call it once to get the x402 PaymentRequired object, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].

name.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com. A full URL or email address is accepted and reduced to its host. Alias: domain.

type.description: ALL (default: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA) or one record type.

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS Records Lookup
